recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, minimalist composition featuring a monochrome, airbrushed illustration of a gymnast performing a hand-balance. The figure interacts with a row of metallic spheres, one of which is a vibrant, saturated red, set against a stark white void with a single horizontal green line at the base.
coreVisualRelationships: The gymnast's extended leg creates a strong horizontal parallel to the top typography.
The red sphere acts as the singular focal point amidst a sequence of desaturated chrome spheres.
The thin green line provides a grounding horizon for the floating, ethereal subject.
coreInvariants: High-contrast black and white figure rendering
Single horizontal green line at the bottom

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The gymnast is centered vertically, occupying the middle third of the frame, with limbs extending horizontally.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The saturated red sphere held by the gymnast.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye moves from the bold blue text at the top, down the gymnast's arm to the red sphere, then follows the horizontal line of spheres and the leg extension.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Dominant white background creates a sense of clinical, futuristic isolation.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Saturated Red (Primary Sphere) and Sky Blue (Typography)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the white background and dark figure; high saturation contrast between the red sphere and the desaturated surroundings.

characterSpecificRedesigns: S and E have distinct horizontal emphasis
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface used for all elements to maintain minimalist 80s tech aesthetic.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the 80s tech/futurist aesthetic and wide proportions.
Classic geometric square-sans that fits the era's graphic language.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate an airbrushed illustration on a pure white background. In the center, a gymnast in a hand-balance pose rendered in high-contrast black and white pencil style. The gymnast holds a glossy, saturated red sphere. A horizontal row of five chrome-finished spheres passes behind the gymnast. At the very bottom, a thin, solid green horizontal line.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add uppercase text at the top center using a bold, extended geometric sans-serif font in a sky blue color. Ensure wide tracking between letters.

verificationChecks: Is only one sphere red while the others are chrome?
Is the text extended and sky blue?
Is there a thin green line at the bottom?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the gymnast

mustAchieve: High-contrast monochrome rendering of the figure

postGenerationChecks: Check for clean edges on the spheres.
Ensure the red sphere is the only saturated element in the center.
Verify the typography is perfectly horizontal and centered.
Confirm the green line is perfectly straight and thin.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Airbrushed Geometric Objects] + [High-Contrast Monochrome Figure] + [Extended Square Sans-Serif] + [Stark White Negative Space] to create a retro-futurist minimalist aesthetic.
